text: List view: vim-style idea cursor over the flat list of visible rows
description: Audit finding (2026-09-28). Idea navigation is not vim-like: j never descends into an expanded idea's children (navigateDown ignores expansion; its dontDescend param is unused), while k descends into an expanded previous sibling only if a stale selectedIncomingIndex is set, so j and k are not inverses. Cursor state is scattered: phase.selectedIdeaIndex lives on data-store Phase entities, floatingIdeaIndex separately, and nested AimUIState.selectedIncomingIndex chains encode the sub-idea path. Target: derive the visible rows of the active column (phase ideas / floating ideas, recursively through expanded ideas) as a flat list of {aimId, path}; the cursor is one row key; j/k = ±1 row (crossing into neighbouring phases at the ends as today), h = collapse or go to parent, l = expand or step into first child, Esc leaves idea mode, J/K reorder, L/H indent/outdent. Remove navigateDown/navigateUp/goToLastChildIdea index juggling and UI fields on entities. Update e2e/navigation.spec l/h test (currently encodes the non-vim behaviour).

status.comment: Slice 1 (j/k over visible rows, e612081a) implemented, in review. h/l already match the target (h collapses or goes to parent, l expands or steps into first child), so no change needed there. Slice 3 (single row-key cursor state) open and waiting on the selection-model decision.
